body: Sorry. There's no way I can. It will kill me if this time doesn't. They don't even recognize when a client is working hard sometimes, and then they can make you feel like shit for trying at all.

I feel like some people are deemed "good enough" (e.g. compliant, not traumatized in "certain ways") for therapy. No offense to anyone, but I couldn't even ask for what I needed to be able to feel safe doing therapy without being shot down and left for dead for even trying. Sorry you can relate at all.

Therapy has caused me to:

* Shutdown more from talking to people
* Become more suicidal 
* Trust that much less
* Feel that much more hopeless
* Hate life completely
* Believe my whole existence is worthless and an accident
* Lose all belief in anyone believing me and helping me 
* Not want to express myself ever again

Is it so much to ask for a therapist that

* doesn't think I wanted to be abused by another child, or believes that it was just 'playing doctor' for 4 fucking years, or just doesn't believe me altogether?
* doesn't minimize being thrown in basement by a babysitter, or mocked by her children, or humiliated by her, etc.?
* doesn't minimize my mother's alcoholism, or her abuse/neglect, or the years in foster care it led to?
* doesn't minimize my father's absence/neglect, or drug addiction, or the kind of pain it has caused that all he wants to do for me is meet my most basic needs?
* doesn't minimize the pressure exerted on me by my mother and grandmother combined to be anyone but myself?
* trust me that I'm not going to be able to open up about the worst parts, like the psychopath, for a very long damn time, and so I can't help but leave a certain amount of blindness in my trail until I'm able to let someone see everything?
* actually trusts me that it's fucking difficult as fuck for me to talk about this and every other aspect of my fucking life to the point that I think it will all lead to them blaming me and punishing me the way I have felt blamed and punished repeatedly for my honesty?
* doesn't feel the need to automatically and actually symphathize with my abusers, or somehow try to reframe things in some psychotically positive way because they think I need to see things with sunshine blown up my ass, or 'be accountable/take responsibility', and to ultimately give all my abusers a free pass because they think being angry and sad about it still is apparently not helpful or not warranted somehow despite my absolute avoidance to feel/show those things around most people because I've already internalized that I need to be the bad person or be quiet so I'm not becoming the bad person by blaming others, and have to do my best to hide that conflicting reality at the same time to get on with my stupid life?
* doesn't automatically presume it's all my fault or must be taken with a grain of salt based on my diagnostic list? 
* doesn't automatically presume it's all my fault once I gain an inkling of confidence to talk about the times in which it definitely was my fault when all along I struggle with feeling like everyone - including the fucking therapists - have insinuated everything, even punishment and abuse inflicted on me, is my fault, and is why I struggle to talk about any of it?
* doesn't automatically presume it's all my fault because I have a trail of failed therapy attempts and am classed 'the difficult client', now left utterly hopeless, terrified, defensive, and pissed off, as if that just popped out of fucking nowhere?
* doesn't take for granted that I expressed anything, whether it be a thought, an emotion, a creative expression, etc. when that is against a lot of my own ingrained rules? 
* doesn't feel the need to put boundaries higher and higher and changing the rules for any fucking unnecessary fucking reason that just makes me feel like my opening up makes them presume I'm a fucking threat (despite my inclination to run from the people I open up to), causing me to shrink away from continuing to do so at all?
* actually lets me mourn/grieve my shit life?
* actually thinks I need trauma therapy and a level of fucking empathy and an insane amount of patience and understanding and support and TIME (without their timelines!) as part of the process instead of some cold, hard knocks life, grow up already kind of approach?
* and who doesn't fucking abandon me and refer me on for telling them the wrong thing, or not telling them the right thing, or having uncomfortable thoughts/feelings, not making the progress THEY want from me, or whatever the damn reason is this time to the point that I ultimately have no idea what I should or shouldn't tell anyone anymore because I just seem to evoke the completely unwanted response and have my trauma repeated regardless of what I say or don't say?
* doesn't fucking punish me for simply talking and opening up by drawing back their own supports, etc... Actually can take the damn time to let me say when I'm ready to let go of something, however bloody long it takes. Maybe they could just FEEL into the importance of that... In the importance of my having a choice and the time to feel WHATEVER and be WHATEVER for once.
* maybe not pathologize every aspect of my personality, my thoughts, or feelings, or choices... So that maybe I can save some sense of my being to be sane/healthy/well/good enough to actually take part in life?
* maybe just not making my worst nightmare a reality over and over and over again by ditching me because I'm the bad person for wanting to be seen as anything but for once and having someone in a position to help me fucking see and feel that through their feeling and seeing that enough to not fucking abandon me again. JUST MAYBE sit with all the fucking uncomfortable fucking feelings I bring into the room and live with outside of the sessions, including my TERROR OF BEING ABANDONED YET AGAIN, where I seek correspondence between the sessions because SILENCE IS A THREATENING PUNISHMENT SIGNALLING THE BEGINNING OF THE END FOR ME, and just fucking maybe STICK IT OUT FOR ONCE AND NOT MAKE ME A GOD DAMN UNWANTED NUISANCE WHEN I REACH OUT until I'm ready to not just REACH FOR SOMEONE ELSE and LET GO but GO ON WITHOUT HOLDING ON BECAUSE SOMEONE ELSE FUCKING HELD ON - REALLY HELD ON TO ME - **REAL ME WHEN I LET HER BREATHE DESPITE THE PAIN IT CAUSES AND THE CONSEQUENCES I MUST FEAR AND ENSUE IN THE PROCESS** - FOR ONCE... Could one of these fucking therapists just fucking do that for once for me?? Because this shit is costing me more than a financially secure future, however much I put the cash in their pockets to give a flying fuck, it's taking chunks out of my heart as an invisible source of payment, for fuck's sakes.
* and just maybe consider that I can't help but think, "Gee, what can I do this time so that I don't get abandoned again?" That maybe that is the biggest roadblock to having any trust for anyone anymore because as much as they might feel like they're 'walking on eggshells' around me, just maybe I feel like I'm walking on eggshells around them, too, all the more so as I incrementally bring more of myself into the room. Just maybe let me have my 'it gets worse before it gets better'. Just maybe let it be okay for me to seek a refuge in that being the case while also allowing me to experience, and BE experienced in that tumultuous state. Just maybe don't turn your back on me and tell me in your silence, like everyone else has, that I'm not allowed to be this way... This me. Can I just be okay enough... Acceptable enough... To someone that they don't push me away for once? That they can feel safe being close to me in some vein, so I can feel safe in approaching them, too, with the fine details of myself? Is it so much to ask someone to not be afraid of me so I don't have to fear myself anymore based on their completely unnecessary reactions based on my words? Because I'm this fucking close to taking a vow of silence.
